problem_statement: BYOM capability experiments need a repeatable Azure resource foundation.
hypothesis: An engineer can provision the gateway, consuming Foundry project, search service, and a separate Sweden Central GPT-5.4 backend through notebooks without manual resource creation or copying connection values.
security_notes: Public authenticated endpoints; backend local key authentication disabled. No service connections, runtime role assignments, key retrieval, or policy-bypass tags. GlobalStandard inference may process outside Sweden. Generated settings are ignored by Git.
setup_time_estimate: 5-10 minutes for local setup; Azure provisioning time varies, especially APIM.
